changelog: Full in-game maps with (mostly) accurate checks placed on them
Full item tracker including weapons, key items, and more
Archipelago check sending from the map
Annotated maps with all the codes and puzzle solutions
Alan does a funny little dance as you get closer to goaling :)
Replaced all the uncompressed map pngs with jpgs, reducing the file size by around 4 times.
Added an additional (larger) layout for 16:9 screens as well as keeping the original 16:10 one
Added red/green filters on the items to more easily distinguish when you receive one
Added the new Herald of Darkness trap and other miscellaneous items
Tracker compatible with version 0.0.9 of the AP
Introduces the option to start as either Saga or Alan, needing to unlock the other through the multiworld
